description: Embark on an extraordinary quest that challenges your resourcefulness and cunning as you navigate a world where purchasing is strictly prohibited. In this unique challenge, a trade deficit has thrown the economy into disarray, leaving vendors unable to sell their goods. Your task is to explore this unforgiving landscape, relying solely on your wit and creativity to obtain the items you need. Uncover hidden treasures, forge alliances with crafters and traders, and uncover alternative methods of acquisition in your quest to overcome the trade deficit. Are you ready to embark on the Trade Deficit Delve, where resourcefulness reigns supreme and ingenuity is your greatest asset?
name: Trade Deficit Delve

rules.description: You cannot buy items at any vendor.
rules.name: No Vendor Purchasing
